title: The stakes rise
base_prompt:
Fully animated cinematic stylized-realistic 3D CGI feature-film shot, continuous motion, expressive character animation and acting, believable fur and cloth simulation, detailed wet stone and metal, dynamic ocean, rain, spray, steam and sparks, cinematic lighting, anamorphic 16:9 widescreen, 24 fps.

Characters (keep exactly on-model): a second barnacled mechanical crab walker, visibly much larger than the first, with heavier armour plates, brighter green conduits, huge iron claws and hissing hydraulic pistons; Penny, a fourteen-year-old girl with windblown auburn curls under a patterned headscarf, freckles, a heavy canvas mechanic's apron full of wrenches, pliers and gears, and a grease-stained linen rag; clever, practical, young-looking.
Camera: tracking along the conduit to the generator gauges; one continuous shot, no cuts.
Action: Green energy surges along the conduit and the generator gauges spin backwards as the giant machine below draws power out of the lighthouse; lamps dim and Penny watches the needles fall.
No dialogue.
Sound: electrical draining whine, falling gauge clicks, hum.
Audio: realistic sound effects and ambience only; spoken dialogue only as written above; no background music; no narrator.
